entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I think I need to return my VeloBand GPS tracker. I just got it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please confirm your full name and order number?
Sure, it's Sarah Miller. The order number is... VF88761.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order here, delivered on December 30th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just find it really hard to use. The whole interface is so confusing, and I guess I just expected more from it, you know? For it to be simpler.
I see. Have you had a chance to look through the tutorials in the VeloFit app?
I tried. I even looked at the user manual online, but it just made me more overwhelmed. It all seems so complicated. Can't you just help me? I don't think this is the right device for me.
Of course, Sarah. I'm sorry to hear it's not working out for you. Let me check the return eligibility right now. One moment, please.

Alright, I've pulled up our policy. Let's see... Yes, according to our knowledge base, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it just 12 days ago, you're well within that window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So I can definitely send it back?

Absolutely. I have just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print that out, place it on the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's it? That was so easy. Thank you so much, David!
You're very welcome, Sarah. Once we receive the device, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
